description: Odisha Higher Education Department signs MoUs for AI, skill development and employability programmes, while launching academic audit and question bank portals.
body_lead: Bhubaneswar: The Odisha Higher Education Department on Saturday signed multiple Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with CSRBOX, Nandi Foundation and Odisha Knowledge Corporation Limited (OKCL) to strengthen skill development, employability and digital learning among students across the state. In collaboration with NASSCOM, the department also launched the ‘AI Course for All’ programme, aimed at providing students and faculty members with opportunities to develop skills in Artificial Intelligence.
